cards.title: 🆕 TGPSC's fix (Oct 26)
cards.body: TGPSC will consider a separate date, possibly Nov 7, for AEE Civil candidates whose SSC JE Civil exam falls on Nov 6. To qualify, submit your SSC hall ticket, your TGPSC application and your OTR ID by 5 pm on Oct 30 (Telangana Today). Only clash-hit candidates are covered; everyone else keeps the original date.

Oct 26: BRS MLA Harish Rao again asked CM Revanth Reddy to step in and move the Roads & Buildings AEE exam (Nov 6). He says over 50,000 civil engineering aspirants are affected, and that SSC has already fixed its schedule. Earlier: Roads Minister Komatireddy Venkat Reddy asked TGPSC to review dates on Oct 14; aspirants protested at TGPSC on Oct 17. Telangana Today reports no govt response so far. No new dates yet.
